name: emw-subset-ts
label: EMwrap Subset TS
help: Create a subset of a tilt-series, tomogram, or particle/coordinate set by selecting tomogram names (rlnTomoName).

params.name: input_set
params.label: Input set:
params.help: Input STAR file: tilt_series.star, tomograms.star, or optimisation_set.star (TomoParticles / TomoCoordinates).

params.name: subset_tomo_names
params.label: Subset Tomo Names
params.help: Space-separated list of rlnTomoName values to keep in the output set.
